title: JustinGuitar Lesson 4 Practice Routine: Finger Warm-ups, D Minor Focus, Strumming, Riff, and Song Work
summary: This short JustinGuitar lesson (Lesson 4) lays out a compact 20-minute practice routine, wrapped into a 6-minute video. It begins with a 2-minute finger-stretch warm-up, followed by 1 minute of focused D minor chord work, then two quick chord-change drills (focusing on the two most difficult transitions, often Dm→Am and a second challenging change such as Dm→E). The routine continues with 2 minutes dedicated to a specific strumming pattern (muted fingers, metronome recommended), then a 2-minute riff exercise featuring Sunshine of Your Love. The bulk of the session is 10 minutes of song work, where students select familiar tunes, memorize the core chords (A, D, E, Am, Dm, Em), and aim to keep a steady strumming pattern while moving through a song. The instructor emphasizes metronome use for rhythm, gradual progression toward faster chord changes (around 30 changes per minute for the D minor family), and the importance of keeping practice enjoyable and progressing to the next lesson when current work becomes unengaging. The video also references left-handed practice content and additional metronome tools on the site.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Finger Stretching Exercise
sections.description: Two minutes on a finger-stretch exercise; keep it slow and avoid pressing too hard to prevent hand fatigue.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Dm Chord Changes
sections.description: One minute on D minor chord practice: place the fingers, strum, lift, and repeat for muscle memory.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Chord Perfect
sections.description: Identify which chord is most difficult and spend extra time on it, adjusting as comfort improves.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: One-Minute Changes
sections.description: Two 1-minute drills focusing on the two hardest chord changes (commonly Dm→Am and another challenging transition).

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Strumming Practice
sections.description: Two minutes dedicated to a 12-beat strumming pattern (Down Down Up Up Down Down Down Up Up Down); mute fingers and focus on legato motion.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Riff Practice
sections.description: Two minutes attempting the riff; acknowledged as challenging but instructional and rewarding.

sections.title: Practice Routine Lesson 4: Practice Songs
sections.description: Guidance on choosing songs (examples given) and dedicating about 10 minutes to song work; memorize core chords (A, D, E, Am, Dm, Em) so you can play with minimal chart support; incorporate the strumming pattern to engrain rhythm in real playing.
